scope: Primary-source leads for AASHTO-named precast/prestressed bridge beams outside the United States and Pakistan. A name does not prove that every ordinate matches a US standard section.

records.organisation: Department of Public Works and Highways, Misamis Oriental 1st District Engineering Office
records.title_original: Rehabilitation of Totally-Damaged Concrete Spillway to Odiongan Bridge 2 and Approaches
records.title_en: Odiongan Bridge 2 project drawing, AASHTO Type VI girder
records.locator: drawing PDS 26/43, 'Typical Prestressed Girder Details, AASHTO, Type VI, L=40.00M 1/2'; Section at Ends and Section at Mid Span
records.printed_dimensions: Indexed drawing text includes repeated 1829 and 1067 mm callouts, corresponding numerically to 72 and 42 inches; the associated dimension lines require visual reading.
records.missing_information: Visually verify the full dimensioned polygon, fillets, and end-versus-midspan changes from the drawing before mapping to an existing US Type VI profile. DPWH PDF host did not resolve via local curl during this pass, though the indexed drawing text was available.
records.contact_route: DPWH Misamis Oriental 1st District Engineering Office; ask for PDS 26/43 source drawing or accessible PDF.

records.organisation: Department of Public Works and Highways
records.title_en: DPWH programme of work naming AASHTO Type IV-B PSC girders
records.locator: Bill of quantities item 406(1)a4.1, L=30.00 m, and item 406(1)a4.2, L=22.50 m
records.printed_dimensions: Girder lengths 30.00 and 22.50 m; no profile dimensions in this source.
records.missing_information: Find associated DPWH Type IV-B section sheet. The IV-B suffix may indicate a local variant, so do not assume US standard Type IV geometry.
records.contact_route: DPWH project planning/design office; request plans associated with programme of work 17J00028.

records.printed_dimensions: Producer states bridge spans up to 40 m; no section drawings or Type I-VI designation.
records.missing_information: Request manufacturer's AASHTO type list and dimensioned mould drawings; marketplace listing is producer-authored but not a drawing. Cross-check local university guide Figure 57 only as a generic AASHTO reference, not proof of fabricated geometry.

records.contact_route: Universidad de Ciencias Comerciales repository and author; request Yahoska Bridge beam drawings.

records.title_original: Diseño de paso a desnivel con viga I de hormigón pretensado Tipo IV AASHTO
records.title_en: Academic grade-separation design using an AASHTO Type IV I-beam
records.locator: printed p. 192, Figure 135 'Dimensionamiento de la viga I, Tipo IV. AASHTO' and accompanying AASHTO properties table
records.printed_dimensions: Figure 135 is described in indexed PDF text as 1.35 m deep, 0.50 m top flange, 0.65 m bottom flange and 0.20 m web; visually verify before using. Rounded metric values alone do not establish polygon equivalence.
records.missing_information: This is an academic design, not evidence of adoption or construction. Visually inspect Figure 135 and all chamfers/haunches; do not map to US Type IV solely by name.
